name: Fable England
notes: Store meta: London, England, GBP base, ships to 212 countries incl. US, CA, GB, AU; 'Fable England weaves narratives into prints & hand-painted jewellery' (https://fableengland.com/meta.json). The US market (/en-us) prices in USD with its own US price list (e.g. Edith Niva Print Tote Bag £48 on the UK feed, $84 on the US feed), so the US feed is used (https://www.fableengland.com/en-us/collections/handbags/products.json?limit=250).

USA delivery: $8.95 standard under $80, free on orders $80 and over, 2–7 business days (https://www.fableengland.com/policies/shipping-policy). 'Easy returns 30 days' for the US store, with a USA returns route (https://www.fableengland.com/policies/refund-policy).

About: began when the founder found a 1940s bee-print scarf at a vintage fair; the bee became its emblem (https://www.fableengland.com/pages/about-us). Named: Green Into the Woods Grab Tote $84 (forest print with fox, doe and owl), Into the Woods Tote Bag $122 ('Our bestselling Tote', printed scarf on the handle, bee plaque), Laura Small Backpack $110, Charlotte Sunflower Top Handle Bag $158.

Mix of the 71 regular-price US-feed bags (2026-10-29): 68 typed Handbag (shoulder, tote, saddle, satchel, circle and top-handle bags, a few small backpacks such as the Laura Small Backpack $110 and Green Into The Woods Buckle Backpack Medium $128), 2 clutches, 1 typed Backpack (https://www.fableengland.com/en-us/collections/handbags/products.json?limit=250).

prices.note: https://www.fableengland.com/en-us/collections/handbags/products.json feed, 95 listings: 2 marked down and 15 sold out excluded, 7 out-of-scope items excluded; 71 regular-price bags, median $110. Low / mid / high: Green Into the Woods Grab Tote $84; Tan Classic Satchel $110; Charlotte Sunflower Top Handle Bag $158. Like-for-like: carry bags at regular price, in stock (totes, shoulder and crossbody bags, satchels, hobos, belt/hip bags, backpacks); luggage, duffels and weekenders, lunch bags, diaper/baby bags, pouches, wallets, wristlets, cosmetic cases, straps, charms, coolers, pet and kids' items excluded.
